title: Yuzvendra Chahal aur Dhanashree Verma ka divorce: asli reason kya hai? 💔
author: Galibazz Desk
description: Indian cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal aur choreographer-influencer Dhanashree Verma ke divorce ki khabar ne social media par kaafi buzz create kar diya hai.
Reports ke mutabik, dono ke beech differences unki life priorities aur career choices ko lekar badhne lage the. Dhanashree allegedly apne career aur lifestyle par zyada focus karna chahti thi.
Wahin Chahal apne cricket commitments aur ek stable personal life ko priority de rahe the, jis wajah se dono ke expectations match nahi ho paaye.
Kuch sources yeh bhi suggest karte hain ki personal space aur lifestyle differences ne relationship ko affect kiya.
Social media par fans alag-alag theories bana rahe hain, lekin ab tak kisi bhi taraf se detailed official statement nahi aaya hai.
Filhaal ke liye, ye kehna sahi hoga ki yeh divorce mutual differences ka result hai, aur exact reason sirf dono hi jaante hain.

title: Are Arshdeep Singh and Samreen Kaur secretly dating? 😳❤️

title: Duniya ke 10 desh jahan mardon se zyada hain mahilaen, dulhon ki pad gayi hai kami!
author: Galibazz Desk
description: Duniya mein kai aise desh hain jahan mahilaon ki sankhya purushon se kaafi zyada hai. Badalte social aur economic halaton ke chalte in deshon mein dulhon ki kami tak dekhne ko mil rahi hai.

1. Ukraine
2. Latvia
3. Lithuania
4. Russia
5. Belarus
6. Portugal
7. Hungary
8. Estonia
9. Armenia
10. Moldova

Ukraine is list mein sabse upar hai, jahan war aur migration ke kaaran male population mein lagataar girawat aayi hai. Latvia aur Lithuania jaise Baltic countries mein bhi mahilaon ki abaadi purushon se kaafi zyada payi jaati hai, jiska ek bada reason male life expectancy ka kam hona hai.
Russia aur Belarus mein bhi kai saalon se women population zyada bani hui hai. Iska kaaran historical factors, health issues aur men ki comparatively kam average age maana jata hai.
Portugal aur Hungary jaise European deshon mein aging population ek bada factor hai, kyunki women generally men se zyada jeeti hain, jisse female ratio badh jata hai.
Estonia aur Armenia mein job opportunities ke liye men ka foreign migration gender balance ko impact karta hai. Isi wajah se in deshon mein women population ka percentage zyada hai.

Moldova mein bhi kaafi sankhya mein men overseas kaam karte hain, jisse country ke andar mahilaon ki sankhya comparatively zyada dikhai deti hai. Experts ke mutabik, aisa gender imbalance future mein social structure aur marriage trends par asar daal sakta hai.

title: Mujhe porn star ka pati kehlane mein koi harz nahi
author: Viral Baba
description: Porn industry se Bollywood mein kadam rakhne wali Sunny Leone aur unke pati Daniel Weber apni ninth wedding anniversary celebrate kar rahe hain.

Reel life mein Sunny jitni bold dikhti hain, real life mein utni hi soft aur simple hain. Daniel ne bataya tha ki unhe pehli baar Las Vegas ke ek restaurant mein dekhte hi woh unhe dil de baithe the.
